extracted.name: Homemade Chicken burger aloha
extracted.description: I made this recipe cause my wife Jennifer loves burgers. So I made my own recipe but since im not a red meat lover I tried making it chicken patties
ingredient_lines: 2 tspn garlic powder and 1 tspn paprika powder
Cut lettuce ice berg put in a cold bowl of water
24 pcs gouda cheese sliced or edam
instruction_lines: In a Big bowl marinate chicken with salt pepper paprika onion garlic powder. Make a circle or palm size patty and cook on low heat.
For dressing Wire whisk all ingredients

For Burger buns Pre heat oven on 200°c In a big mixing bowl put the water yeast and sugar.wait until it bubbles Then add the flour. Lastly the softended butter.. Then make a dough and round the dough in burger size and wait them until they rise and cook for about 10 to 15mins.
Assemble Burger Buns Ketchup dressing Cheese Chicken patty Pineapple Letuce Dressing Burger Buns
